notes: Held in Wells Hall on the MSU campus. Bring your own sack lunch.
name: Filmmaker Camp (Michigan State University)
what_you_do: Study what makes a great movie, then write, film, edit and polish your own short films in a group. The week ends with a screening in a campus theater.
who_can_apply: Grades 9 to 12 (ages 14 to 18). The page does not state how many spots there are.
pay_detail: $495 in 2026. Covers equipment, one group lunch, and the camp film link. Financial aid or scholarship is available.
duration: One week, Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. 2026 dates were July 13 to 17.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was July 13 to 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Now link on the camp page. For financial aid, email Pete Johnston at john2950@msu.edu.
